{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|arg= global

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Returns array with all items assigned to the [[primaryWeapon]] except magazines. Use [[primaryWeaponMagazine]] command for the latter. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

|s1= [[primaryWeaponItems]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [muzzle, rail, optic, bipod]
* muzzle: [[String]] - class name of the muzzle attachment (silencer, flash hider)
* rail: [[String]] - class name of the rail attachement (laserpointer/flashlight)
* optic: [[String]]
* bipod: [[String]]

|x1= <sqf>
primaryWeaponItems player;
/*
[
	"muzzle_snds_H",	// silencer
	"acc_pointer_IR",	// laser
	"optic_Aco",		// optics
	"bipod_01_F_blk"	// bipod
]
*/
</sqf>

|seealso= [[addPrimaryWeaponItem]] [[removePrimaryWeaponItem]] [[removeAllPrimaryWeaponItems]] [[weaponAccessories]] [[weaponAccessoriesCargo]] [[handgunItems]] [[binocularItems]] [[secondaryWeaponItems]] [[weaponsItems]] [[weaponsItemsCargo]]
}}
